# Bundled third-party browser assets

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: https://getbootstrap.com/ — MIT, copyright notice retained in CSS/JS headers.
- Chart.js 4.4.4: https://www.chartjs.org/ — MIT, copyright notice retained in JS header.
- Barlow and Fraunces fonts: Google Fonts distributions under the SIL Open Font License. License files are included alongside the font files.

These versions match the application's previous Bootstrap/Chart.js dependencies. Fonts and scripts are served locally for a reliable demonstration without CDN access.
